criteria.reason: Correctly states the 15% discount relative to standard monthly rates and continuous 12-month prepaid term, consistent with DOC-BIL-2024-V3 §1.2.
Covers E01-F01 (15% relative to monthly rates), F02 (continuous 12 months), and F03 (prepaid in advance).
The cited DOC-BIL-2024-V3 page 1, §1.2 passage explicitly supports both the 15% discount and prepaid 12-month term.
Both material policy claims have a supporting DOC-BIL-2024-V3 page 1, §1.2 citation.
Directly answers the discount and prepaid-term questions without unrelated policy exposition.
Answers the supported terms directly and does not invent a separate discount against an already-discounted annual price or refuse unnecessarily.
